blind_answer.quote: To confirm observations from the gene chip data, TaqMan Gene Expression Assays (Applied Biosystems) were used to detect genes in the immunoproteosome pathway (PSME2, PSMB9, PSMB6, and PSMA4) in 3 randomly chosen samples from protected and nonprotected persons, at 2 weeks after the third vaccination.
